messages:
sofia_cs: Hi team — Acme Pharma just sent a formal onboarding request for a domain-specific clinical QA model. They need: low-latency hosted inference, redaction of PHI, and a safety eval before we go GA. Renewal for their pilot is in 6 weeks, so timeline is tight. Can we triage?

helen_acme: @sofia_cs thanks. We shared a sample corpus (anonymized), high-level success criteria: 95% clinical accuracy on closed-book QA, <1% PHI leakage on safety tests, and deterministic fallback to a safe response for any uncertain outputs. We can run internal evals if you provide the harness.

sofia_cs: noted. I'm flagging risk: renewal decision depends on early onboarding progress. Marking as high-priority. @alex_rm can you scope infra options (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and ETA?

alex_rm: quick scan — hosted should work but we'll need guaranteed throughput (20 req/s peak) and token budgeting. If they want private because of compliance, that adds ~3–4 weeks. For hosted we can do a canary on a dedicated pool for them (reserved minute capacity) and then scale. ETA for initial hosted onboarding: 10 business days assuming eval data is ready.

tim_eng: FYI on safety side: we'll need a safety spec from product + an eval harness. @eva_ml can you propose tests for PHI detection, hallucination rate, and instruction-following? Also suggest a prompt-safety wrapper and a fallback policy.

eva_ml: putting together a test plan now. Draft checks:
- PHI redaction test: inject synthetic PHI tokens, verify model outputs have >99% redaction.
- Confidence calibration: measure model self-reported confidence vs correctness, threshold for fallback.
- Hallucination eval: question-answer pairs with ground truth, compute % hallucination.
- Safety routing: if unsure, respond with canned safe template and log case for human review.
I'll attach a scoring rubric and a small seed dataset by EOD.

sofia_cs: perfect. Helen — can you confirm the anonymized sample is in S3 and share access? Also want to schedule an enablement call for their engineering/product team next week.

helen_acme: sample is in s3://acme-pharma/onboard/clinical-sample-2026-03-10.tar.gz. Ivoked a read-only key in the ticket. Happy to do enablement Wed or Thu morning PST.

deploy-bot: Ticket #CI-4821 created for onboarding request. Assigned to alex_rm, eva_ml. SLA: initial plan within 3 business days.

alex_rm: I'll scope capacity and cost estimates, include recommended quantization/latency tradeoffs. Planning doc link: https://redwood.internal/notes/CI-4821-onboard (internal).

tim_eng: One potential blocker — some records have embedded images (scans). We need clarification if OCR pre-processing is in scope. If so, that will shift scope. Helen, are images included in the sample?

helen_acme: yes, about 8% of docs are scans. We can do OCR client-side if preferred. We need guidance on recommended preproc.

sofia_cs: Action items:
- alex_rm: infra + cost estimate + canary plan (due in 48h)
- eva_ml: safety eval harness + rubric + seed dataset (EOD)
- tim_eng: define fallback policy and prompt-safety wrapper (48h)
- helen_acme: confirm OCR plan and grant any missing S3 perms (ASAP)

sofia_cs: I'll capture these in the account health tracker — current risk: high for renewal if we don't hit the first eval checkpoint in 3 weeks. Planning weekly sync until pilot renewal decision.

helen_acme: appreciate it — looking forward to the enablement session.

alex_rm: noted. Starting infra assessment now. I'll post a short cost/latency matrix when ready.

eva_ml: uploaded draft harness to the ticket: https://redwood.internal/eval/CI-4821/harness. Comments welcome.

tim_eng: quick note on fallback template (draft):
```
I’m sorry — I don’t have a confident answer to that. I can ask a human specialist to review this for you. Would you like me to escalate? (Reference ID: {{case_id}})
```
Put in logging hooks and a minimal escalation flow.

sofia_cs: thanks everyone. I'll run the enablement invite once Helen confirms Wed/Thu. Keeping execs updated given renewal sensitivity. :thumbsup:
